The '''Senate War Rally''' was an event that occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which was done to promote the war effort. It was held by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], led by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

[[Standard hour/Legends|Hours]] before the rally, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at [[Palpatine's Statue Garden]] to inform the Supreme Chancellor that he would not be able to make it to the event, as he and a Jedi task force had been dispatched to track down the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].
